attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Missouri military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption for all military retirement income (Group B). Special provision: National Guard/Reserve drill pay also excluded. Active duty, Reserve, and Guard pay exempt. MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt.

initial_action.action_postfix: "MO Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Full exclusion - 100% of military retirement pay excluded from MO taxable income. Special: Active duty, Reserve, and Guard pay exempt.
